MYSTIX.Name: Mystic Points
MYSTIX.Hint: A second, GM-awarded pool that can be used for anything Hero Points can do.

SheetWidget.Label: Mystic Points
SheetWidget.Tooltip: Mystic Points {value}/{max} — a second, GM-awarded pool usable like Hero Points.
SheetWidget.SpendHint: Click to spend a Mystic Point on a Hero-Point-style use. Right-click to award (GM only).

Dialog.AwardLabel: Points to award (or negative to remove)
Dialog.AwardHint: Awards are added to the actor's current value, clamped to the Mystic Point maximum.
Dialog.SetMaxHint: The pool size for this actor. Set to 0 to hide the widget for them.
Dialog.RerollBody: Spend 1 Mystic Point to reroll this check? {actor} has {value} left.
Dialog.SkipRefreshHint: Exclude this character from the automatic Mystic Point refreshes (session start and encounter start). Manual awarding and spending are unaffected.

Chat.RerollNoPoints: {actor} has no Mystic Points to spend.
Chat.RerollNotCheck: Only d20 checks can be rerolled with a Mystic Point.
Chat.RerollFailed: MystiX | Reroll failed — Mystic Point refunded.

AwardDefaultMax.name: Default Max Mystic Points
AwardDefaultMax.hint: Maximum Mystic Points for characters that haven't had one set individually.

HeroPointsEnabled.name: Hero Points Stay Enabled
HeroPointsEnabled.hint: Keep the regular Hero Point pool visible and usable alongside Mystic Points.

ChatReroll.name: Enable Mystic Reroll Context Menu
ChatReroll.hint: Adds a 'Reroll with Mystic Point' option to chat message context menus.

AutoOpenHud.name: Open Party HUD on World Load
AutoOpenHud.hint: Automatically open the party tracker when the world finishes loading (GM only).

RefreshOnSession.name: Refresh Mystic Points on Session Start
RefreshOnSession.hint: When the world loads, refill every character's Mystic Points to full. Happens at most once per calendar day, so reloading the world doesn't refresh again.

RefreshOnEncounter.name: Refresh Mystic Points on Encounter Start
RefreshOnEncounter.hint: At the start of each combat, refill every character's pool to full — or grant a fixed amount, depending on the refresh style below.

EncounterRefreshStyle.name: Encounter Refresh Style
EncounterRefreshStyle.hint: Refill tops every pool up to full at the start of each combat. Fixed grants a set number of points per encounter, accumulating toward each character's max instead of resetting it.

EncounterGrant.name: Fixed Encounter Grant
EncounterGrant.hint: Mystic Points granted to every character at the start of each combat when the refresh style is 'Fixed grant per encounter'.

Errors.GMOnly: Only the GM can do that.
Errors.NotCharacter: Mystic Points are only available on character sheets.

HUD.Title: MystiX — Party Points
HUD.KeybindingHint: Show or hide the MystiX party tracker panel.

ActorLog.Title: MystiX — Mystic History: {actor}
ActorLog.ButtonTooltip: View this character's full Mystic Point history
ActorLog.Empty: No logged Mystic Point activity for this character yet.

Report.Title: End-of-Session Mystic Report
Report.EmptyLog: MystiX | No logged Mystic Point activity to report yet.
Report.CloseBody: Post the end-of-session Mystic Point report card to chat?

Refresh.AnnounceFixed: Mystic Points granted for the encounter (+{amount} each):
Refresh.Manual: Mystic Points refreshed manually for the party.

EffectCard.ChooserPoints: You have {value} Mystic Point(s). Choose an effect:
EffectCard.BonusDescription: Gains a +{bonus} circumstance bonus to checks for {rounds} round(s) (Mystic Surge).
EffectCard.StabilizedDescription: Mystic energy knits flesh and spirit — the dying condition is removed.
EffectCard.NoConditionDescription: Not dying — the mystic power finds no wound to mend (point spent).
EffectCard.Failed: MystiX | Effect failed — Mystic Point refunded.
EffectCard.NoEffects: MystiX | No custom effects are enabled. Ask your GM to configure them.

Manager.Title: MystiX — Custom Mystic Effects
Manager.Hint: Effects appear in the spender chooser for every character. Toggle, edit, or add your own.
Manager.EnabledTooltip: Whether this effect appears in the spender chooser
Manager.NameRequired: MystiX | The effect needs a name.
Manager.TypeHint: Bonus adds an in-system modifier; Stabilize removes the dying condition; Message posts a chat card only.
Manager.BonusHint: The circumstance bonus granted while the effect lasts.
Manager.RoundsHint: How long the bonus effect lasts.
Manager.TextHint: Shown on the chat card for message-only effects.
Manager.DeleteBody: Delete '{name}'? Players will no longer be able to choose it.
